title: Sexual Harassment
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, the office grapples with the introduction of a sexual harassment policy review prompted by a resignation due to harassment allegations. Michael struggles with the new restrictions on humor and speech, leading to conflicts with HR and his coworkers. Meanwhile, Toby conducts a seminar emphasizing that intent does not excuse harassment, and Michael attempts to find a suitable joke for the seminar but ultimately resists the changes. The episode also features interactions involving Pam's mother and the introduction of Michael's lawyer, who specializes in free speech issues.
